text: A construction project has begun at the rear of my brother Jim's place. Ongoing updates to follow ...
It is about to be removed and sold.
There's brother Jim visiting with the neighbor.

Update on the ongoing construction project at brother Jim's store in Rome NY, the store of my youth, my father's former grocery store. 

One does not lose their ability to construct even after many years. 

Such skills come back quickly and naturally. 

There is a joy in constructing and knowing how to construct.

Words of ancient wisdom:

A sense of fulfillment and completion comes with the ability to physically construct.  

All men and women, young and old, should engage in some sort of physical construction project, whether it be sewing a suit of clothes, rebuilding an airplane, or building an outhouse.

In this way, as in many other ways, people all over the world are the same. 

It is this sense of sameness, such common denominators, that link all of us on the planet together, whether we be men or women, young or old, rich or poor, from this nation or that.

Everywhere in the world, all infants and children are quite similar, yet as youths age into adults, they do become adulterated.  

It is this adulteration process that differentiates us.

Fortunately for some, because of the unconventional ways in which we think, we are able to overcome this adulteration process to a degree, and help other do the same, but only if they are willing.
